description:
EIA weekly natural gas storage report (Bcf, lower-48 working gas): the
    released headline injection/withdrawal plus, on pro scope, `pending` —
    our estimate of the report that has NOT been published yet, built from
    weather-driven demand and LNG feedgas components — and
    `last_verified` (estimate vs actual with realized error), alongside
    out-of-sample accuracy and backtest stats. Every week also carries the
    market expectation (`consensus_bcf`, pre-release snapshot) and the
    surprise against it (`actual_minus_consensus_bcf`) — our `est_bcf` is a
    model nowcast, not the consensus; `reading` spells out the signs. Demo
    scope returns only the already-published actual.
name: get_us_natural_gas_storage_nowcast
